question: What is the Resulticks acquisition supposed to unlock — revenue synergies or cost savings?

beats.line: The Resulticks acquisition is positioned as a revenue synergy play, not cost savings.
beats.headline: REVENUE SYNERGY
beats.action: Two halftone documents slide together from opposite edges; an arrow drops between them and holds.

beats.line: The one point five billion dollar deal adds AI-driven customer data to Diginex's sustainability and compliance platform.
beats.headline: $1.5B
beats.action: The joined documents fold upward into a paper screen that lights and settles centre frame.

beats.line: That turns a point solution into an integrated end-to-end platform.
beats.headline: END-TO-END
beats.action: The screen widens as paper tiles snap along its edge, forming one continuous band.

beats.line: The move is about expanding addressable market and cross-sell opportunity.
beats.headline: CROSS-SELL
beats.action: The band unrolls into a paper map that spreads flat across the frame.

beats.line: Enterprise customers can be served across two workflows: sustainability and compliance, and customer intelligence.
beats.headline: TWO WORKFLOWS
beats.action: The map creases down the middle and lifts into two paper folders standing side by side.

beats.line: Firms buying ESG compliance can now buy customer data from the same vendor, increasing wallet share.
beats.headline: WALLET SHARE
beats.action: The folders tip together and paper coins pour from one into the other, stacking up.

beats.line: The risk is integration complexity — four distinct acquisitions absorbed across multiple geographies.
beats.headline: 4 ACQUISITIONS
beats.action: The coin stack scatters and four paper buildings land apart, each on its own patch.

beats.line: General and administrative costs rose three point four million to eight point one million in the first half.
beats.headline: $8.1M G&A
beats.action: The buildings compress into one rising paper bar that climbs and locks in place.

beats.line: Two point two million of that came from merger and acquisition legal work — integration is resource-intensive.
beats.headline: $2.2M LEGAL
beats.action: The bar peels into stacked legal documents that pile heavily and tilt.

beats.line: What matters next is cross-sell traction, and growth outpacing the cost of integration.
beats.headline: CROSS-SELL TRACTION
beats.action: The pile flattens into a calendar page; a paper hand enters and points at it.
